tagline: 6-DOF desktop serial manipulator with 6808 slew-bearing turntable, MG996R/MG90S servo kinematics, PCA9685 16-ch PWM driver & parallel spur-gear gripper
description: Commercial 6-axis desktop robot arms like the uFactory Lite 6 ($1,299), Elephant Robotics myCobot 280 ($599–$799), or Hiwonder JetMax ($699) charge a 10x markup for injection-molded shells and basic hobby servo kinematics. This DIY alternative combines 9 structural PETG/PLA+ printed links with $62.90 of off-the-shelf MG996R/MG90S metal-gear servos, a 6808 thin-section turntable bearing, PCA9685 I2C PWM driver, ESP32-S3, and 6V 10A PSU.
functionSummary: Executes 6-DOF inverse kinematics (azimuth waist J1, dual-torqued shoulder pitch J2, cantilever elbow J3, inline forearm roll J4, wrist pitch clevis J5, and parallel spur-gear gripper J6) driven by an ESP32-S3 over I2C to a 12-bit PCA9685 PWM generator.

originalProduct.name: Hiwonder / uFactory Desktop 6-Axis Programmable Robotic Arm
originalProduct.whyExpensive: Proprietary machined/molded link housings, closed controller firmware, and 800% educational robotics distributor markup over standard metal-gear servos and thin-section bearings.

keyMechanisms: J1 azimuth waist turntable riding on a preloaded 6808-2RS thin-section ball bearing (40×52×7mm) for zero radial play
J2–J3 triangulated truss lower arm and cantilever elbow housing driven by high-torque 11 kg·cm MG996R metal-gear digital servos
J4–J5 inline hollow forearm roll tube and differential wrist pitch clevis minimizing distal inertia
J6 synchronous spur-gear parallel linkage gripper with compliant textured jaws driven by an MG90S micro metal-gear servo
engineeringNotes: Print PRT-01 (Base Pedestal), PRT-03 (Shoulder Yoke), and PRT-04 (Lower Arm Link) in PETG with 4 perimeter walls and 35% gyroid infill to resist bending moments.
All bearing seats include a +0.15mm press-fit radial allowance and 45° lead-in chamfer for 6808-2RS and 608ZZ bearings.
Packs across 2 build plates on a Bambu Lab A1 / P1S / X1C (256×256×256 mm) with zero support material.
materialsNeeded: PETG Filament (~360g) for high-load base pedestal, turntable, shoulder yoke, lower arm truss & elbow housing
PLA+ Filament (~180g) for lightweight forearm roll barrel, wrist clevis, gripper frame & geared jaws
3× MG996R + 3× MG90S Metal-Gear Servos + 6808-2RS Bearing + PCA9685 PWM Driver + ESP32-S3 + 6V 10A PSU
